summary: Food and beverage website for cold pressed beetroot juice with different variants, bottled in 180ml bottles
architectural_notes: Product: cold pressed beetroot juice with variants
UPI payment integration with QR code on checkout
Admin dashboard for viewing contact submissions

existing_features.title: Create a hero section featuring the Beat o Beet brand logo (circular design with beetroot illustration, '100% NATURAL VITALITY' text, and 'HEALTHY JUICE DRINK' tagline) as the centerpiece. Display the tagline '100% Natural Vitality' prominently and include a compelling headline about cold pressed beetroot juice.

Create a product showcase section displaying different beetroot juice variants in 180ml bottles. Each product card should show the bottle, variant name, key features, and benefits. Include at least 3-4 juice variants (e.g., Pure Beetroot, Beetroot-Apple, Beetroot-Ginger, Beetroot-Carrot).
Create an 'About Our Process' section explaining the cold pressing method, health benefits of beetroot juice, and what makes the product 100% natural with no additives or preservatives.
Create a 'Health Benefits' section highlighting nutritional advantages of beetroot juice including improved blood circulation, natural energy boost, antioxidants, and vitamin content.
Create a 'Where to Buy' or contact section with a simple form for wholesale inquiries, retail locations, or order information.
Implement a responsive navigation menu with links to Home, Products, Benefits, About, and Contact sections. Include the Beat o Beet logo in the navigation header.

Apply a natural, earthy, and organic visual design theme inspired by the Beat o Beet logo's kraft paper aesthetic. Use warm earth tones (beige, tan, cream) as backgrounds, deep burgundy/beetroot red for primary actions and accents, and forest green for secondary elements. Typography should feel handcrafted and approachable with a mix of script/handwritten fonts for the brand name and clean sans-serif for body text. Create visual consistency across all sections with organic shapes, natural textures, and an overall wholesome, healthy food brand feel.
Create a CartContext in frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx that manages cart state with actions to add items, remove items, update quantities, clear cart, and calculate total price
Update ProductCard component to include an 'Add to Cart' button that uses CartContext to add the product to the cart with quantity 1, and show a success indicator when item is added
Add a cart icon with item count badge to the Navigation component that opens a cart sidebar when clicked

Create a CartSidebar component in frontend/src/components/CartSidebar.tsx that displays cart items with product name, variant, quantity controls, individual price, line total, overall cart total, and buttons to proceed to checkout or close the sidebar

Create a CheckoutPage component in frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx with a form collecting customer name, email, and shipping address, displaying order summary with cart items and total, and a submit button to place the order
Create an OrderConfirmationPage component in frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage.tsx that displays order ID, success message, order details, and a button to return to home
Update App.tsx to wrap the application with CartProvider and configure routing for checkout page (/checkout) and order confirmation page (/order/:orderId)
Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for useProducts (fetches product list), useSubmitOrder (submits order), and useOrder (fetches order by ID)
Display the user-provided UPI QR code image on the checkout page with the business name 'Mysore Food Labs' prominently shown above or near the QR code

Update the ContactSection component (frontend/src/components/ContactSection.tsx) to submit form data to the backend using the submitContactForm function instead of opening a mailto link, and show success feedback after submission

Create an AdminDashboardPage component in frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.tsx that displays all contact form submissions in a sortable table with columns for customer name, email, address, message, and submission date
Update App.tsx to add a route for the admin dashboard page at /admin/dashboard
Create a React Query hook useContactSubmissions in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that fetches all contact form submissions using the getAllContactSubmissions backend function
Create a React Query mutation hook useSubmitContactForm in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts that submits contact form data to the backend
Add a visible navigation link or button to access the admin dashboard at /admin/dashboard in the Navigation component (frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx)

Display an acknowledgement message or modal immediately after the customer clicks the 'Place Order' button on the CheckoutPage, confirming that the order has been submitted successfully before navigating to the order confirmation page

Create an AdminProductsPage component in frontend/src/pages/AdminProductsPage.tsx that displays all products in an editable table with columns for product image preview, name, variant, price (in INR), description, benefits, stock status, and action buttons to edit or delete each product

Create a ProductEditModal component in frontend/src/components/ProductEditModal.tsx that allows editing product details including uploading a new product image, updating name, variant, price (in INR), description, benefits array, and stock status

Create React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for useUpdateProduct (mutation to update product data) and useDeleteProduct (mutation to delete a product), both invalidating the products query on success
Add route for admin products page at /admin/products in App.tsx and add a navigation link to access it from the Navigation component alongside the existing admin dashboard link

Handle product image uploads by accepting image files in the ProductEditModal, converting them to data URLs or uploading to frontend/public/assets/products/ directory, and updating the product's imageUrl field with the new image path

new_feature_requests.summary: Create website for cold pressed beetroot juice product
Add shopping cart functionality for direct customer purchases

Create a backend data model for Product with fields: id (Text), name (Text), variant (Text), price (Nat - representing cents), description (Text), benefits (Array of Text), imageUrl (Text), and inStock (Bool)
Create a backend data model for CartItem with fields: productId (Text), quantity (Nat), and addedAt (Int - timestamp)

Create a backend data model for Order with fields: id (Text), items (Array of CartItem), customerName (Text), customerEmail (Text), shippingAddress (Text), totalAmount (Nat - in cents), status (OrderStatus enum: Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled), createdAt (Int), and updatedAt (Int)
Implement backend function getProducts() that returns an array of all available products with their current stock status

Implement backend function submitOrder(items: [CartItem], customerName: Text, customerEmail: Text, shippingAddress: Text) that creates a new order, calculates total amount, assigns a unique order ID, sets status to Pending, stores the order, and returns the order ID
Implement backend function getOrderById(orderId: Text) that retrieves order details including items, customer information, and current status
Add UPI payment method with QR code on checkout page using provided QR code image, displaying business name 'Mysore Food Labs'
Create backend data model for ContactSubmission with fields: id (Text), customerName (Text), customerEmail (Text), address (Text), message (Text, optional), submittedAt (Int - timestamp)
Implement backend function to store contact form submissions with all customer details
Create admin dashboard page to view all contact form submissions in a sortable table with columns for name, email, address, submission date
Create a backend data model ContactSubmission with fields: id (Text), customerName (Text), customerEmail (Text), address (Text), message (Text optional), submittedAt (Int timestamp)

Implement backend function submitContactForm(customerName: Text, customerEmail: Text, address: Text, message: ?Text) that creates a unique ID, stores the contact submission with timestamp in a stable Map, and returns the submission ID
Implement backend function getAllContactSubmissions() that returns an array of all stored contact form submissions sorted by submission date (newest first)
Add order acknowledgement confirmation after customer clicks 'Place Order' button
Add ability to update product images and pricing on the website

Implement backend function updateProduct(productId: Text, name: Text, variant: Text, price: Nat, description: Text, benefits: [Text], imageUrl: Text, inStock: Bool) that updates the product data in the stable storage and returns a success boolean
Implement backend function deleteProduct(productId: Text) that removes a product from stable storage and returns a success boolean
